evidence.summary: Customers leave a 1 to 5 star rating and a comment on a product.
Reviews appear after a purchase is confirmed.
GET /v2/products/{productId}/reviews lists reviews for a product (API version 2).
POST /v2/products/{productId}/reviews leaves a review with a rating 1-5 and a comment.
The spec has no request or response schemas, no security scheme, no error responses and no endpoint for shop replies.

features.name: List product reviews
features.description: Show the reviews left on a product.
features.business_logic: Only reviews tied to a confirmed purchase appear (see C-F04).

features.name: Leave a product review
features.description: A customer rates a product 1 to 5 stars and writes a comment.
features.business_logic: Rating is between 1 and 5; a comment accompanies it (whether it is required is not documented).

features.name: Shop replies to reviews
features.description: The shop can post a reply to a customer's review.
features.observed_behaviour: Not observed; mentioned in the overview only, with no API endpoint in the spec.
features.business_logic: Unknown (how many replies, who may reply, editing).

features.name: Verified-purchase reviews
features.description: A review is shown only after the reviewer's purchase is confirmed.
features.observed_behaviour: Not observed; one sentence in the overview.
features.business_logic: Visibility depends on a confirmed purchase; whether unpurchased reviews are refused or held back is not documented.

unknowns: Request and response schemas, field names and types: the spec lists only paths and summaries. A fuller spec or the vendor's docs would settle it.
Authentication: no security scheme in the spec.
Shop replies: described in the overview but no endpoint or data shape is documented.
What 'purchase confirmed' means and where it is checked (Reviewly or the shop); whether reviews without a purchase are refused or hidden.
Moderation, editing and deleting reviews: not documented.
Stack and architecture: closed product, nothing documented; not inspected beyond the two public files given.
